key_findings.text: The two assembly activity estimates link to distinct illustrative records; they are not exhaustive physical cycles.
The inspection example keeps the result unknown rather than turning an activity into a pass or a quality score.

limitations: Every value and record is hand-authored simulated data. No video, document, audio or model was used.
In a real recap, sampled images may miss actions, scene edits or continuing activity. They do not establish continuous visual coverage.
Reference instructions describe expectations; they do not prove actions happened or confirm workflow steps.
Hidden defects, calibrated tolerances, fastening torque and overall quality or safety require other evidence.
